试试应用名、拼音全拼或首字母，例如“wx”: Try an app name, full pinyin, or initials, e.g. "wx"
拖到这里，从该分组移除: Drop here to remove from group
拖动标题或卡片可调整顺序: Drag the title or cards to reorder
搜索应用，支持拼音首字母，如 wx / vsc: Search apps, supports pinyin initials like wx / vsc
分组中的应用不会被卸载，只会移除这个分组。: Apps in the group are not uninstalled; only the group is removed.
添加应用为快捷工具…: Add an app as a quick tool…
快捷工具显示在侧边栏和“全部应用”顶部；可以把常用应用加进来。: Quick tools appear in the sidebar and atop All Apps; add your frequent apps.
占用量在后台测量并缓存。更新或卸载应用后可以重新计算一次。: Usage is measured in the background and cached. Recalculate after updating or uninstalling.
应用占用 = 应用本体 + 该应用在 Library 中的数据；内存为运行中全部: Disk = app bundle + its Library data; memory = sum of all its running processes
请按住 ⌘ / ⌥ / ⌃ / ⇧ 中的至少一个，esc 取消: Hold at least one of ⌘ / ⌥ / ⌃ / ⇧; esc to cancel
快捷键、菜单栏图标和应用占用统计: Shortcuts, menu bar icon, and app usage stats
按下这个组合键会在任何应用中唤出搜索框，输入后回车即可打开应用。: This combo opens the search box from any app; type and press Enter to launch.
系统没有接受这个组合键，可能被其他应用占用了，换一个试试。: The system rejected this combo, possibly taken by another app. Try another.
菜单栏图标可以打开搜索框、应用架窗口和本设置面板。: The menu bar icon opens search, the AppShelf window, and this panel.
给分组一个容易辨认的名称和图标: Give the group an easy-to-recognize name and icon
这个分组还没有应用: This group has no apps yet
可以添加一个 .app，或切换到其他分组。: Add a .app, or switch to another group.
拖应用进来添加，拖出去移除: Drag an app in to add, out to remove
